# Visionary Path Services

> Guiding Dreams, Financing Futures. Pan-India education loan advisory providing 100% free guidance to students and parents for higher education in India and overseas.

## Organization Details
- **Name:** Visionary Path Services
- **Website:** https://www.visionarypathservices.com
- **Helpline:** +91 9063703038
- **Email:** Visionarypathservises@gmail.com
- **Operating Hours:** Monday – Saturday: 9:30 AM – 7:00 PM IST
- **Coverage:** Pan-India student support
- **Service Fee:** 100% Free guidance (Zero charges from students/parents)
- **Role:** Advisory & lender matching platform (Non-lender bridge between students and 15+ partner banks and NBFCs)

## Core Advisory Services
- [Abroad Education Loans](https://www.visionarypathservices.com/pages/abroad-loans.html): Secured and unsecured loan options up to ₹2 Crores for international universities. Pre-visa sanctions, I-20 proof of funds, GIC funding for Canada, and Blocked Account financing for Germany.
- [Domestic Education Loans](https://www.visionarypathservices.com/pages/domestic-loans.html): Loans for premier Indian institutions including IITs, IIMs, NITs, and central/private universities.
- [MBBS Education Loans](https://www.visionarypathservices.com/pages/mbbs-loans.html): Specialized medical degree financing for MBBS in India (government and private colleges) and MBBS Abroad (Russia, Philippines, Europe, Central Asia).
- [Other Loans](https://www.visionarypathservices.com/pages/other-loans.html): Guidance for personal loans, home loans, and loan against property (LAP) to support related educational or family needs.
- [Partner Lenders](https://www.visionarypathservices.com/pages/partner-lenders.html): Official network of leading financial institutions including Public Sector Banks (SBI, Bank of Baroda, PNB, Canara Bank, Union Bank), Private Banks (ICICI, IDFC FIRST, Axis Bank), and NBFCs (HDFC Credila, Avanse, Auxilo, InCred, Tata Capital, Poonawalla Fincorp).

## Country Guides
- [Study in USA](https://www.visionarypathservices.com/pages/countries/usa.html): Loans up to ₹2 Cr, STEM OPT 3-year extension, I-20 funding proof, non-collateral options up to ₹75 Lakhs.
- [Study in UK](https://www.visionarypathservices.com/pages/countries/uk.html): Russell Group universities, 1-year Master's financing, CAS deposit, UKVI 28-day fund rule compliance, 2-year Graduate Route visa.
- [Study in Canada](https://www.visionarypathservices.com/pages/countries/canada.html): SDS visa support, tuition fee + GIC account (CAD 20,635) direct funding, PGWP work permits up to 3 years.
- [Study in Germany](https://www.visionarypathservices.com/pages/countries/germany.html): Public university zero tuition support, Sperrkonto (German Blocked Account €11,904) financing, 18-month Jobseeker visa.
- [Study in Australia](https://www.visionarypathservices.com/pages/countries/australia.html): Group of Eight (Go8) university funding, Genuine Student (GS) assessment compliance, OSHC health cover.
- [Study in Ireland](https://www.visionarypathservices.com/pages/countries/ireland.html): European tech hub education financing, 1-year Master's programs, 2-year Stamp 1G post-study work visa.
- [Study in France](https://www.visionarypathservices.com/pages/countries/france.html): Grandes Écoles, MBA & English-taught programs, Campus France financial verification, CAF housing assistance.
- [Study in New Zealand](https://www.visionarypathservices.com/pages/countries/new-zealand.html): British-style degree programs, ANZ Bank Funds Transfer Scheme (FTS - NZD 20,000) funding, post-study work visa up to 3 years.
- [Study in Dubai (UAE)](https://www.visionarypathservices.com/pages/countries/dubai.html): International branch campuses (Heriot-Watt, Wollongong, BITS, SP Jain), rapid student visa processing, tax-free earnings.
- [Study Across Europe](https://www.visionarypathservices.com/pages/countries/europe.html): Netherlands, Sweden, Italy, Spain, Switzerland; multi-currency financing and Schengen visa fund compliance.

## Key Student Benefits
1. **Unbiased Multi-Lender Comparison:** Compare interest rates, processing fees, margin money, and repayment moratoriums across 15+ lenders.
2. **Pre-Visa Sanction Letters:** Fast-track sanction letters required for visa filing and university admissions.
3. **No Service Charges:** 100% free counseling for students.
4. **End-to-End Assistance:** From initial profile assessment and document preparation to bank sanction and loan disbursement.
